text:
## Verification Checklist  
For **Every New Customer**, verify:  
- [ ] Photo ID obtained and genuine
- [ ] Customer face matches ID photo
- [ ] ID document is valid (not expired)
- [ ] Proof of address dated within 3 months
- [ ] Customer name matches documents
- [ ] Address matches documents
- [ ] Copies securely filed
- [ ] System record complete
- [ ] No sanctions list matches  
**If Any Check Fails:** Do not open account. Escalate to manager.

raw_entities.name: New Customer Identity and Address Verification
raw_entities.description: A mandatory verification process for every new customer requiring collection and validation of photo ID, proof of address, and confirmation that customer identity matches documentation. The process includes checks for document genuineness, validity, currency, and name/address consistency, with secure filing and system recording of all verification steps.
context: For Every New Customer, verify: Photo ID obtained and genuine
Proof of address dated within 3 months

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Screening
raw_entities.description: A mandatory AML screening check performed as part of new customer onboarding to verify that the customer does not appear on any sanctions lists. This check is a required component of the verification checklist and must be completed before account opening.

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Verification Documentation Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory obligation to obtain, verify, and securely file copies of all customer identification and address documents, and to maintain a complete system record of all verification checks performed during new customer onboarding.

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Escalation Obligation
raw_entities.description: A mandatory obligation to refuse account opening and escalate to a manager if any verification check fails during the new customer onboarding process.
context: If Any Check Fails: Do not open account. Escalate to manager.
